stack.backend: Django 5 + DRF + PostgreSQL + Redis + Celery + Channels
stack.frontend: Vue 3 + Vite + Pinia + Vue Router + Axios

critical_rules.rule: All monetary values must be Decimal('X.XX'). Never float.
critical_rules.why: Float arithmetic causes rounding errors in financial calculations.

critical_rules.rule: Never call .delete() on business entities. Use is_active=False + is_deleted=True.
critical_rules.why: Maintains audit trail. Exception: CartItem and management commands.

critical_rules.rule: No emoji or multibyte Unicode in .py files. Plain ASCII only.
critical_rules.why: Causes SyntaxError in Python which generates 500 in production.

critical_rules.rule: ViewSets orchestrate HTTP only. All mutations in Commands with @transaction.atomic.
critical_rules.why: Separation of concerns; testability; atomic consistency.

critical_rules.rule: dispatch_notification and ws_notify ONLY inside transaction.on_commit(lambda: ...).
critical_rules.why: Prevents notifications firing on rolled-back transactions.

critical_rules.rule: Always 'from users.api.permissions import IsAdminUser' (checks is_staff AND is_superuser).
critical_rules.why: rest_framework.permissions.IsAdminUser only checks is_staff, not is_superuser.

critical_rules.rule: All Wompi webhook views must call _verify_wompi_event_signature() before DB mutation.
critical_rules.why: Prevents replay attacks on payment webhooks.

critical_rules.rule: No 'role' field on User. Profile is in accounts.UserProfile.user_type (CUSTOMER|TECHNICIAN|PROFESSIONAL|SPECIALIST).
critical_rules.why: DDD separation: auth in users/, profiles in accounts/.

critical_rules.rule: Use UUID in public URLs, never integer PK. SintelBaseModel provides uuid.
critical_rules.why: Security: prevents enumeration attacks on resource IDs.

critical_rules.rule: Use stock_record.stock (select_for_update) for inventory writes, never InventorySelector.get_current_stock().
critical_rules.why: Selector may return stale cached value under concurrent load.

critical_rules.rule: Always call confirm_order_payment() from payment/shared/commands.py. Never duplicate inventory/notification logic.
critical_rules.why: confirm_order_payment is idempotent and handles all post-payment side effects.

critical_rules.rule: Filter coupons by active=True + valid_from__lte=now + valid_to__gte=now. Cap discount with min(discount, total_items_price).
critical_rules.why: Prevents expired/inactive coupons from being applied.

critical_rules.rule: All business models must inherit from SintelBaseModel (provides uuid, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted).
critical_rules.why: Ensures consistent soft-delete, UUID URLs, and audit timestamps.

architectural_decisions.decision: users/ handles auth only. accounts/ handles profiles (UserProfile, TechnicianProfile).
payment/shared/commands.py:confirm_order_payment() is the Single Source of Truth for post-payment logic.
dispatch_notification() replaces ws_notify in all 8 callers. Supports WS/Email/WhatsApp channels.
quotes.AdditionalCost removed. Each app has its own CostRule model + PricingCalculator.
IsBuyerOrAdmin for cart/orders/renting. IsServiceProviderUser for CV/skills/agenda.

patterns.selector: NombreSelector with @staticmethod read-only methods returning QuerySet or Model
patterns.viewset: Inherits ReadOnlyModelViewSet/GenericViewSet/CreateModelMixin, never writes directly to DB
patterns.model: Always inherits SintelBaseModel, soft-delete via is_deleted
